record_title: Two-prime-support admirable numbers: a complete converse classification
scientific_context: A complete converse classification of admirable integers with prime support exactly {2,p}: the known construction mechanisms exhaust the case, and the odd-prime exponent is forced to be 1 or 3.
limitations: Restricted to integers 2^a p^b with one odd prime p. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the 1960 Sachs article was not inspected in full text, and an equivalent observation could exist in older problem or sequence literature.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer verification of the classification for 366,282 bounded parameter triples plus a targeted high-p-adic-valuation scan.
Deterministic verification output: 45 bounded admirable hits, zero classification mismatches, and zero high-valuation hits.
